description:
Predict a matchup's winner from the current ratings -- for analysis.

Uses Glicko-2 win probability under the same formula matchmaking
uses internally. Use it to analyse a ranking, or AFTER a vote to
compare the cast vote with what the ratings expected. Never show a
prediction to a voter before they vote: a voter who sees who
"should" win anchors on it, and the preference data stops being
independent. Does not record a vote — read-only.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_predict_matchup_winner
